title: RPN Calculator
description:
Reverse Polish Notation uses a stack:
```
> 3 4 + 2 *
14
> 5 1 2 + 4 * + 3 -
14
> 2 +
Error: not enough operands
```
hints: Every two-operand operator is the `+` case with a different line in the middle. Pop `b` first: in `5 2 -` the 2 is on top, and the answer is `a - b`.
`std::stod` throws when a token is not a number. Until you meet exceptions in milestone 9, check first: `std::isdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(token[0]))` (or a leading `-` followed by a digit).
stretch: convert normal infix `(3 + 4) * 2` to RPN with the shunting-yard algorithm.
